d:
Bihar ki rajniti men Lalu Yadav ke MY samikran ko lekar naee bahas chhir gaee hai. Prashant Kishor aur Asaduddin Owaisi ki sakriyta ke bich Shahabuddin ke parivar se mulakat ke siyasi mayne nikale ja rahe hain. kya muslim vot baink men RJD ki pakar ko chunauti mil rahi hai? kya jan suraj aur AIMIM bihar men nae rajnitik samikran banane ki koshish kar rahe hain? Shahabuddin ke ghar pahunchne ke pichhe kya hai Prashant Kishor ki ranniti aur iska RJD ki rajniti par kya asar par sakta hai? dekhie puri riport.
